name: settings-larger-text
note: Four steps into a nested Settings list. The two Settings sublists are the fingerprint pair that needs a nav title to tell them apart, so this flow exercises screen identity as well as navigation.
human: Tap Settings on the home screen.
Tap Larger Text, and stop there.

name: contacts-kate-bell
note: An indexed list with a search field, two steps deep. Short on purpose: a flow this shallow is where a per-step overhead shows up as a ratio rather than being absorbed by navigation.
human: Tap Contacts on the home screen.
Tap Kate Bell, and stop there.
